title: Detail
description: What a module shows behind its card: an ordered list of typed blocks. The surface draws each kind the same way for every module, so a new module gets a full working view without a new template.

columns.description: kanban: columns with cards. table: column headers.

rows.description: table: rows of cells. A cell is a string, a number, or {text, href} for a link, or {badge, tone} for a marker.

body.description: document: markdown, rendered by the surface.

ref.description: document: what to open for the full text (a reader ref).

items.description: links: things to open — inside the cockpit or another tool.
